name: Tempester n°17: LFO Restart = Play moved out of Timer 1 (muted voices, SPI race)
explanation: Bug n°4 (voices muted until power-off). [routine] (IPL 7) ran the LFO Restart = Play loop itself at each loop end and at Play: for each voice it read the sound in the external SRAM ([routine]: PORTA, PMADDR, SRAM CS) and sent 0xEA00/0xEA01 on SPI3 with its own voice select, then deselected every voice. Timer 1 preempts [routine] (IPL 4), which keeps one voice selected from [address] to [address] while it streams 0xF000 + 63 sound words read from the SRAM by PMP auto-increment, then 0xD6xx and 0xFC00 + 8 words: a preemption cut the burst, the voice kept waiting for the missing words and later parsed sound bytes as commands (0xFD = self-calibration loop). Now Timer 1 only sets a pending byte ([address]: .bss padding referenced nowhere, zeroed at boot) in both copies of the loop (slave and master paths; the loops become unreachable), and [routine] (IPL 4, cannot preempt Timer 2 or Timer 3) runs the same loop at its entry, before it processes the tick counted by Timer 1, through [routine] and [routine] (word under di): same words, same voices, LFO sync counters +0x68/+0x6C zeroed before T4 counts the tick, as before; delay at most one Timer 4 period (200 us) plus the IPL-4 latency. Voices whose pad is >= 0x21 (free, 0x7F) are skipped with the test Timer 2 itself uses; the original read a foreign sound for them. 6 words in place, 38 words at 0x9D07C000.

edits.why: j [address] ; T1 slave path: was "jal [routine]" (start of the Play restart loop). Skip the loop to its exit (lbu t4,0x2(s6)); the interrupt state was not changed, so the closing [routine] is skipped too.
sb t8,-0x7f0c(gp) ; delay slot, was "addiu s0,s4,-0x14c8": [address] = 1 (t8 = 1): Play restart pending
j [address] ; T1 master path: was "jal [routine]". Skip the loop to its exit (b [address]).
sb s7,-0x7f0c(gp) ; delay slot, was "addiu s4,s8,0x6b14": [address] = 1 (s7 = 1): Play restart pending
j 0x9d07c000 ; T4 entry after the prologue and the IFS0 clear: was "lui a0,0xa001" (replayed by the stub)
lbu t0,-0x7f0c(gp) ; delay slot, was "lw v1,-0x653c(a0)" (replayed by the stub): t0 = Play restart pending
bne t0,zero,0x9d07c010 ; nothing pending: back to T4 at once (4 instructions per T4 pass)
lui a0,0xa001 ; delay slot (both paths): original [address]
sb zero,-0x7f0c(gp) ; consume the request before acting: a request set meanwhile by T1 is kept for the next pass
lbu s2,0xc(s0) ; s2 = pad of the voice (0x7F = free)
beq t0,zero,0x9d07c07c ; pad >= 0x21: no sound of its own (same test as T2 [address]), skip
lhu a0,-0x7e12(gp) ; delay slot: a0 = current beat, as T1 [address]
ori a0,zero,0xea00 ; delay slot: LFO1 phase restart word
jal [address] ; [routine](0xEA00, voice): select, word, deselect, under di
sw zero,0x68(s0) ; LFO1 sync counter, as T1 [address]
ori a0,zero,0xea01 ; delay slot: LFO2 phase restart word
sw zero,0x6c(s0) ; LFO2 sync counter, as T1 [address]
addiu s0,s0,0x70 ; delay slot: next voice
